does: Finds the file of a video name: walks the loaded mods from the last to the first, builds the path of the name with each extension the video manager accepts (code:ls::VideoManager::GetVideoPath) and answers the first that exists packed or loose.

evidence.says: loops over the mod manager's modules downwards, compares a path prefix with the text Video, calls code:ls::VideoManager::GetVideoPath and tests each candidate with the packed-file and file-exists checks

Osi.MoviePlay(host,'Splash_Logo_Larian',1) in a test level: a count-only probe saw it called once, from bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x1BBBE6E inside code:ecl::VideoManager::NextVideo, and code:ls::VideoManager::GetVideoPath 16 times from inside it (the loaded mods walked); code:ls::VideoManager::LoadVideo itself 0 times: the movie player inlines it

questions.ask: Probe it while a video starts and compare the path it answers with the files of the game's video package.
